summary: Air Force Academy metal tower in El Paso County, CO, possibly built 1957 after a 1956 construction-site fire; removed around 1980; no source describes what remains.

facts.design: approximately 30-foot metal tower of local design with an approximately 7 by 7 foot cab
facts.status_note: Removed around 1980 according to the register

events.note: Wildfire escaped from the Academy construction site around September 1956; the register says the lookout was built after it
Register says possibly 1957, by the Air Force Academy
Register says removed around 1980; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the tower Removed
Registered October 30, 2011; nominated by Kent Argow

corrections.why: The register describes a metal tower of local design and does not name steel.

notes_for_editor: Dates rest on one register description, which says 'possibly' for the 1957 build. The FFA list only repeats the Removed status. Material corrected from steel to metal; height_m 9.1 is converted from the register's approximately 30 feet. No access source, so access is omitted. The staffed-for-a-few-years statement has no year, so it is not an event. Nothing describes remains on the site.
